name: 85387 · Surprise, AZ
findings: ZIP 85387 (Surprise) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85387 (Surprise) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85387 (Surprise) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
